hook.name: TheMint
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing ERC-402 coin minting with tiered seigniorage fees (25% buy / 99% sell at launch, decaying to 5% / 25% over 15 minutes) collected in the quote currency via return-delta. A moneyer-controlled boolean gate blocks all swaps until `openTheMint()` is called; each buy updates the coin's strike price to the all-in execution price paid.
